summary: Quantity division across dimensions (`mg / d`) normalizes the units and rounds the result to zero
`Interval[null, null]` evaluates to null instead of an interval with unknown bounds
Fluent overloads on sibling profiles are ambiguous because the translator types both operands as the base resource
`is Interval<T>` returns false for an interval with a null boundary (fix merged 2026-10-08, not yet released)
A terminology-filtered medication retrieve throws `Unable to extract codes from fhirType Reference` when `MedicationRequest.medication` is a Reference
Overload resolution and casts ignore subtypes when the argument is a Choice of sibling profiles
`is` / `as` of a list whose tuple has a null element, or of an empty list, returns null and drops union branches
Raw `FHIR.dateTime` values in `sort` or a comparison abort with `not comparable`
FHIRCommon `toDayNumbers` / `daysInPeriod` build an invalid interval for a period shorter than 24 hours
FHIRCommon `prevalenceInterval()` returns null for an inactive Condition with no abatement end
